
```{r}
srt_sub   <-ScaleData(srt_sub,assay = "SCT")
srt_sub   <-FindVariableFeatures(srt_sub,nfeatures = 100,)
x <- mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@neighbors$neighbors_pca.SCT_30@nn.idx[ all_cells %in% sub_cells, ]
data <- GetAssayData(str_sub,assay = "SCT",layer = "data")

column_ha = ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(sample.name = srt_sub$sample.name,
                                              clust = srt_sub$kNN_pca.SCT_30_res.2,
                                              col = list(sample.name = setNames( c( "red", "green","blue"),unique(srt_sub$sample.name)),
                                                         clust = setNames( paletteer::paletteer_d("Polychrome::glasbey",n = 16) %>% c(),levels(srt_sub$kNN_pca.SCT_30_res.2))))
mat_data <- data[c(VariableFeatures(srt_sub),"Cd14"),] %>% as.matrix() %>% t() %>% scale() %>% t()
mat_data[mat_data>2] <- 2
mat_data[mat_data<-2] <- -2

ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(mat_data,
                        show_column_names = FALSE,
                        top_annotation = column_ha,
                        clustering_distance_rows = "pearson")
```

```{r}
srt_sub   <-SCTransform(srt_sub)
srt_sub   <-FindVariableFeatures(srt_sub,nfeatures = 2000,assay = "SCT")
srt_sub <- FindClusters(srt_sub,resolution = 2,graph.name =  "kNN_pca.SCT_30")
data <- GetAssayData(srt_sub,assay = "SCT",layer = "data")

column_ha = ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(sample.name = srt_sub$sample.name,
                                              clust = srt_sub$kNN_pca.SCT_30_res.2,
                                              col = list(sample.name = setNames( c( "red", "green","blue"),unique(srt_sub$sample.name)),
                                                         clust = setNames( paletteer::paletteer_d("Polychrome::glasbey",n = 16) %>% c(),levels(srt_sub$kNN_pca.SCT_30_res.2))))
mat_data <- data[VariableFeatures(srt_sub),] %>% as.matrix() %>% t() %>% scale() %>% t()
mat_data[mat_data>2] <- 2
mat_data[mat_data<-2] <- -2

ht_opt$fast_hclust = TRUE

cor_dist_row <- as.dist(1 - cor(t(mat_data)))         
rows_hc <- fastcluster::hclust(cor_dist_row)

cor_dist_col<- as.dist(1 - cor(mat_data))         
col_hc <- fastcluster::hclust(cor_dist_col)

ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(mat_data,
                        show_column_names = FALSE,
                        top_annotation = column_ha,
                        cluster_rows = rows_hc, 
                        cluster_columns = col_hc,
                        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 1))
```

```{r remove-high-cc}
srt_sub <- SCTransform(srt_sub)
srt_sub <- FindVariableFeatures(srt_sub, nfeatures = 2000, assay = "SCT")
srt_sub <- FindClusters(srt_sub, resolution = 2, graph.name = "kNN_pca.SCT_30")

# ── Gene exclusion ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1. Genes correlated with cell-cycle scores — computed on the full object
#    for robust estimates (more cells → better correlations)
CC_COR_THRESH <- 0.5  

full_data <- GetAssayData(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")
cc_scores  <- mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@meta.data[, c("S.Score", "G2M.Score")]

# Compute gene × {S.Score, G2M.Score} correlations efficiently via crossprod
common_cells <- intersect(colnames(full_data), rownames(cc_scores))
expr_t        <- t(full_data[, common_cells])          # cells × genes (dense slice)
cc_cor        <- cor(as.matrix(expr_t), as.matrix(cc_scores[common_cells, ]))

cc_genes <- rownames(cc_cor)[apply(cc_cor, 1, max) >= CC_COR_THRESH]
cat("CC-correlated genes excluded:", length(cc_genes), "\n")

# 2. Pattern-based exclusions
pattern_genes <- grep("^Hsp|^Hspa|^Hsph|^Rps|^Rpl|^Malat1",
                      rownames(full_data), value = TRUE)
cat("Pattern-excluded genes:", length(pattern_genes), "\n")

exclude <- union(cc_genes, pattern_genes)

# ── Filter HVGs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
hvg_filtered <- setdiff(VariableFeatures(srt_sub), exclude)
cat("HVGs remaining:", length(hvg_filtered), "of", length(VariableFeatures(srt_sub)), "\n")

# ── Heatmap ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
data <- GetAssayData(srt_sub, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")

column_ha <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
  sample.name = srt_sub$sample.name,
  clust       = srt_sub$kNN_pca.SCT_30_res.2,
  col = list(
    sample.name = setNames(c("red", "green", "blue"), unique(srt_sub$sample.name)),
    clust       = setNames(
      paletteer::paletteer_d("Polychrome::glasbey", n = 16) %>% c(),
      levels(srt_sub$kNN_pca.SCT_30_res.2)
    )
  )
)

mat_data <- data[hvg_filtered, ] %>%
  as.matrix() %>% t() %>% scale() %>% t()
mat_data[mat_data >  2] <-  2
mat_data[mat_data < -2] <- -2

ht_opt$fast_hclust <- TRUE

cor_dist_row <- as.dist(1 - cor(t(mat_data)))
rows_hc      <- fastcluster::hclust(cor_dist_row)

cor_dist_col <- as.dist(1 - cor(mat_data))
col_hc       <- fastcluster::hclust(cor_dist_col)

ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(mat_data,
                        show_column_names = FALSE,
                        top_annotation    = column_ha,
                        cluster_rows      = rows_hc,
                        cluster_columns   = col_hc,
                        row_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 6))
```
